name: Vampire
description: A regular, non-animated paint that serves as an aesthetic coating for your tank. Its color scheme might potentially offer some camouflage benefits, but besides that, the paint does not offer any functional gameplay advantages.
interestingFacts: The paint was created as part of the Evil War event and was removed from the players' garages after it ended.
The paint could have been obtained forever by completing the special mission “Evil War” and winning the war in the period from October 25 to November 1, 2019.
This was a temporary paint since the Ghost paint faction won the war. It was removed from all garages after the event was over.

Garage description
A regular, non-animated paint that serves as an aesthetic coating for your tank. Its color scheme might potentially offer some camouflage benefits, but besides that, the paint does not offer any functional gameplay advantages.

Interesting facts
The paint was created as part of the Evil War event and was removed from the players' garages after it ended.
The paint could have been obtained forever by completing the special mission “Evil War” and winning the war in the period from October 25 to November 1, 2019.
This was a temporary paint since the Ghost paint faction won the war. It was removed from all garages after the event was over.
